message: workflow V_name has exported=V_exported, but V_where V_verb it
why: `exported` on the workflow and exports.workflows (the symbol table) are two representations of one fact. The stripper reads the scalar; the linker reads the table. When they disagree, one believes the symbol is reachable and the other believes it does not exist — the artifact then works or breaks depending on which tool ran first.
